warnings: Steel roof frame: 'TRUSS T1' printed on every grid line 1-9, each drawn from the A' eave to the C' eave across the classroom and the corridor (section A-A on A-07 shows the same gable truss spanning both). Span = 1.60 + 6.50 + 2.00 + 1.60 = 11.70 (printed chain). The end trusses on grids 1 and 9 carry a separate flag only because they sit on the end walls.
'L 50x50x3.2มม' printed in every bay along row C between the steel corridor posts — recorded as steel_member with element_id null (the label is a section designation, not a mark).
Purlins 'แปเหล็ก C-100x50x20x3.2มม @1.00-1.05ม' are drawn as dashed lines over the whole roof; their number is not printed, so they are one area entry, not one element per line.

Not recorded as elements (drainage, not structure): 'รางระบายน้ำฝนสังกะสี หนาไม่น้อยกว่า 0.23มม' along both eaves, 'ท่อระบายน้ำฝนสังกะสี ด้านหลัง 5 จุด' / 'ด้านหน้า 4 จุด' (RD. marks), and 'แนวสันหลังคา' (ridge line).
Truss T1 member sizes are on S-08 (section file หน้า25).
